eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Inyo, CA; at 6:03 PM on JUL 27, 2026 Effective until 6:03 PM JUL 28, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Monday, July 27, 2026, 6:00 PM:  This is a downgrade from an evacuation ORDER to a WARNING for zones 103, 117-A, 117-B, 117-C 123-A. Zones 123-B, 137-D remain under the WARNING.  The area affected are Big Pine Canyon/Fish Springs/Aberdean/Fort Independence. Unknown duration for warning.  Visit https://ready.inyocounty.us/ for updates. Monday, July 27, 2026, 6:00 PM: This is a downgrade from an evacuation ORDER to a WARNING for zones 103, 117-A, 117-B, 117-C, 123-A. Zones 123-B, 137-D remain under the WARNING.  The area affected are Big Pine Canyon/Fish Springs/Aberdean/Fort Independence. Unknown duration for warning. Those with large animals please take to the Tri-County Fair Ground, use the Mule Days Office Entrance, 1141 North Main Street, Bishop, CA 93514 or Lone Pine High School Farm at: 665 E Inyo Street, Lone Pine, CA 93545.  Visit https://ready.inyocounty.us/ for updates.
